messages.content: The first day’s DA position is submitted. I’ve booked a morning battery cycle, an evening peak discharge, and reserves where the projected SoC can back them. I’ll reassess at each watch as prices and weather update.

All three DA gates are covered. The battery book now uses the full 562.5 MWh discharge allowance, so I’ll preserve the remaining cycles for the evening peaks. The latest weather run shows clouds moving into North Texas on the final day; I’ll watch for changes to solar output and prices.

The final peak discharge is frozen in the book. I’ve added 20 MWh of charging in the last hour as a buffer against uncertain RegDn delivery and the end-of-window SoC penalty. I’ll now run the book through final settlement.
